engine.construction: 20 overlapping tranches, one rebalanced per session; tranche = equal-weight buy-and-hold basket from the open of t+1 to the open of t+21 (label window); daily portfolio return = equal-weight mean of live tranches' daily returns (JT convention); daily statistics weight each session by exposure = live tranches/20 (fixed 1/20 capital per tranche, idle cash) so every tranche counts equally; NAV/drawdown = fixed-capital program
engine.mark_to_market: EXACT daily open-to-open marks from ml/data/equity_eod_snapshot.parquet (forward-filled gaps), exit mark pinned to 1 + y_raw_20d; not amortised
engine.truth: clean model_dataset labels for every model; frozen preds joined on (date,ticker), phantom dates dropped, frozen `fwd` not used
engine.universe: clean-labeled harness rows (y_clean_20d), 113 signal dates 2026-04-01..2026-09-11, ~1,557 names/date; liquid tercile = cs_rank_turnover >= 0.67 (~515 names/date)

baskets.top_decile: long top 10% by score, equal weight (~156 names)
baskets.ls_decile: long top decile minus short bottom decile, $1/$1
baskets.liq_*: same, ranked and formed inside the liquid tercile only (~52 names per decile)

engine.costs: per side, netted against the tranche being replaced (steady-state; ends imputed with median turnover); '20bps_no_netting' = every tranche fully bought and sold
engine.annualisation: tranche: mean 20d net return x 252/20 (12.6 bets/yr); daily: mean x 252, vol x sqrt(252)
engine.segments: by signal date: cv = 2026-04..07 folds, holdout = 2026-08-03..09-11, combined = all
engine.bootstrap: month-block, B=1000, seed 108, paired draws across series within a segment
engine.capacity: AUM (Rs crore) at which the 10th-percentile entering name trades 5% of its 20-session median daily turnover (median over steady-state tranches)

selection_contamination.lgbm_fs_selected: feature subset + k chosen on all 4 CV test folds (univariate AUC on CV test rows, permutation importance on 2026-06 test rows, k by CV mean): only the holdout is untouched
selection_contamination.lgbm_fs_selected_clean: same fixed config as lgbm_fs_selected: only the holdout is untouched
selection_contamination.baseline_mom: fixed C=1.0, no tuning (clean on every window)
selection_contamination.rl_reinforce: champion's 10 features + 3 (feature list inherited from CV-selected subset)

regime.definition: state = sign of the mean (over signal dates in the month) universe-median y_raw_20d; adversarial = at least half of the 10 scorers have negative mean daily IC or negative gross L-S decile spread in that signal month

deflated_sharpe.method: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014): PSR(SR*) = Phi((SR-SR*) sqrt(T-1) / sqrt(1 - g3 SR + (g4-1)/4 SR^2)); DSR = PSR(SR0), SR0 = sqrt(V[SR_n]) ((1-gamma) Phi^-1(1-1/N) + gamma Phi^-1(1-1/(N e))). SR, skew, kurtosis at DAILY frequency of the net (20 bps) daily mark-to-market series, combined OOS program; V[SR_n] = variance of the daily SRs of the 60 scorer x basket trials of this grid.
deflated_sharpe.skill_metric: long baskets: net active return vs equal-weight universe (vs EW liquid tercile for liq_ baskets); long-short: net L-S return

n_trials.note: cost levels are not counted as trials (monotone in cost; 20 bps fixed in advance as the realistic level). N_program = 30 is a floor: 26 logged beat_mkt_20d configs + hyper-parameter grids of RF/XGB/MLP/LR.
